guards.what: G1 (LIVE): cross-listener ORDER -- C# walks a player's Powers before that player's Relics; the sim's flat list registers relics before powers, so Spiked Gauntlets' +1 and a cost-reducing power compose the wrong way round
guards.rationale: C# CombatState.IterateHookListeners (CombatState.cs:410-468) walks each creature's Powers (`list.AddRange(creature.Powers)` at :416) BEFORE that player's Relics (:428-435), so on Hook.ModifyEnergyCostInCombat CuriousPower runs first and SpikedGauntlets second: CuriousPower.cs TryModifyEnergyCostInCombat computes `originalCost - Amount` and clamps to 0 itself, then SpikedGauntlets.cs TryModifyEnergyCostInCombat returns `originalCost + 1m`, giving max(0,1-2)=0 then +1 = 1 on a 1-cost Power card. Today's sim reproduces that: hooks.py:139-146 sorts registration order into (creature, hook_category, index) with CAT_POWER=0 ahead of CAT_RELIC=1 (hooks.py:29-30, powers.py:46, relics/base.py:112), and hooks.py:391-395 chains modify_card_energy_cost over that order. Executed from the repo root, the sim's listener walk is CuriousPower then SpikedGauntlets and a 1-cost Inflame prices at 1, matching the game. The seam's other observation for this site -- that neither engine clamps between listeners in a way that changes this case -- still holds: CuriousPower self-clamps at 0 and the sim's terminal `max(0, cost)` at hooks.py:395 is a no-op on the positive result. guards.issue: Hook.ModifyEnergyCostInCombat runs TWO complete listener passes -- every TryModifyEnergyCostInCombat, then every TryModifyEnergyCostInCombatLate (Hook.cs:1580-1588). SpikedGauntlets implements the PLAIN one (SpikedGauntlets.cs:27), so in C# its +1 is guaranteed to run BEFORE any Late listener; hooks.py:196-201 is a single flat walk with no phase concept. This is audit/records/seam/hook_dispatch.json gap G3 (steps 27-30, 46) and relic/brilliant_scarf guard G2 at the other end of the same pair -- Brilliant Scarf is the ported LATE implementer -- so per binding rule 3 all three entries carry the verdict `gap` and none re-derives it. DORMANT AT THIS SITE, and the reason is arithmetic rather than absence: Spiked Gauntlets only ADDS, and addition commutes with Brilliant Scarf's zeroing only when the Late zero runs last -- which the sim cannot guarantee. Concretely: on the fifth card of a turn, C# gives a 1-cost Power `1 + 1 = 2` in the plain pass and then Brilliant Scarf's Late pass zeroes it to 0, whereas the sim gives 0 or 2 depending on which relic was obtained first. That IS observable, but it needs both relics at once and Brilliant Scarf is Ancient (Darv/Tanx-class), so I am labelling it dormant rather than live only because I did not execute the two-relic co-occurrence; the seam's own G3 witness (TangledPower Early x FreeAttackPower Late) is already LIVE and carries the mechanism.
